description: Track pet care: feeding, walks, vet visits and medications per pet.

faqs.a: Add your pet's name first, then log activities: select the pet, choose feeding/walk/vet/medication, and save.
faqs.q: How do I log pet care?

faqs.a: The medication type stores the medicine name and dose in the note field — the log keeps a dated record of every dose.
The latest entry per pet and activity type is summarized at the top.
In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.

howto: Add a pet with the Add Pet field.
Select the pet and the activity type (feeding, walk, vet, medication).
Add details/notes and click Log Activity.
Check the per-pet summary and full log below.
title: Pet Care Tracker
